description.en: Small branching floating shoots carry overlapping two-lobed leaves.
description.zh: 细小分枝浮生枝条带重叠双裂叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Azolla; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Azolla 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Flattened branching mosaics of overlapping scales differ from clover leaves and the large paired floats of Salvinia.
distinctness.zh: 重叠鳞叶构成的扁平分枝镶嵌区别于四叶蕨及槐叶萍大型成对浮叶。

modeling_brief.en: Design a connected branching unit with stepped leaf tiles; mat extent is a composition choice rather than another variant.
modeling_brief.zh: 用阶梯状叶瓦建立连续分枝单元；覆盖范围仅为构图选择，不另计变体。

uncertainty: Generic floating habit is supported; select a fossil species before final organ details.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Ferns laboratory 7
